name: Athletics
text: Doing physically demanding tasks like balancing, running, climbing, and so on.

name: Sneak
text: Hiding from people, or doing something without people noticing.

name: Notice
text: Noticing hidden, secret, or just hard-to-notice things.

name: Convince
text: Persuading someone to believe you, scaring them to do what you say, and otherwise using words (and the threats/facts behind them) to change their behavior.

name: Expertise
text: Knowing useful information, and/or training in a niche skill that requires specific knowledge.
